error.REGISTRY_CORRUPT: Your saved account list could not be read because the file is damaged. It was left untouched so nothing was lost. Restore a backup copy or move the damaged file aside, then try again.
error.LABEL_EMPTY: Enter an account name. Blank spaces alone cannot be used.
error.LABEL_TOO_LONG: Use {{max}} characters or fewer for the account name.
error.LABEL_CONTROL_CHARS: Account names cannot contain hidden control characters. Use ordinary letters, numbers, or punctuation.
error.DUPLICATE_LABEL: An account named "{{label}}" already exists. Pick a different name.
error.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Could not find an account matching "{{target}}". Refresh your accounts and try again.
error.ACCOUNT_SELECTOR_REQUIRED: Choose or name an account first, then try again.
error.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Account "{{label}}" is disabled. Enable it first before switching or signing in.
error.CANNOT_DISABLE_ACTIVE: Cannot disable "{{label}}" while it is active. Switch to another account first.
error.CANNOT_DISABLE_LAST: Cannot disable "{{label}}" because at least one account must stay enabled.
error.CANNOT_REMOVE_ACTIVE: Cannot remove "{{label}}" while it is active. Switch to another account first.
error.CANNOT_REMOVE_DEFAULT: Cannot remove "{{label}}" because your primary account must stay in the list.
error.INVALID_REORDER: Could not update the account order because the list changed. Refresh your accounts and try again.
error.SWITCH_IN_PROGRESS: Another account switch is already running. Wait a moment for it to finish, then try again.
error.CHROME_BUSY: Flow Chrome is busy right now. Wait for the current job or action to finish, then try again.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Not signed in to Flow yet. Open Accounts and select Sign in (or run npm run login), then sign in to Google in the Chrome window.
error.NOT_IN_PROJECT: No Flow project is open right now. Open a project in the Flow Chrome window or start a new project.
error.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: This action belongs to "{{expectedLabel}}", while "{{activeLabel}}" is active. Switch to "{{expectedLabel}}" first, then try again.
error.NOTHING_TO_RETRY: Nothing to retry on the active account. Only failed jobs or incomplete image batches can be retried.
error.CDP_PORT_OCCUPIED: Another program on this computer is blocking Flow Studio's browser connection. Close conflicting apps and try again.
error.CDP_WRONG_PROFILE: The connected Chrome window belongs to a different browser profile. Close all Flow Chrome windows and try again.
error.CDP_UNAVAILABLE: Flow Studio could not reach the Flow Chrome window. Close Chrome and reopen it from Accounts.
error.PROFILE_MISSING: The browser folder for "{{label}}" is missing on this computer. Select Sign in in Accounts to set it up again.
error.PROFILE_LOCKED: This account's Chrome profile is already open in another Chrome window. Close that Chrome window first, then try again.
error.CHROME_NOT_FOUND: Google Chrome could not be found on this computer. Install Google Chrome or set your Chrome path, then try again.
error.CHROME_START_FAILED: Chrome opened, but Flow Studio could not connect to it in time. Close the Chrome window and try again.
error.CHROME_NO_CONTEXT: The Flow Chrome window has no open browser window. Close Chrome and reopen it from Accounts.
error.UNSAFE_ACCOUNT_PATH: Could not move that account folder safely because its location points outside Flow Studio's accounts folder.
error.PATH_OUTSIDE_ALLOWLIST: That file location sits outside the folders Flow Studio is allowed to access.
error.REMOTE_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the running Flow Studio server. Make sure Flow Studio is still open and try again.
error.BODY_TOO_LARGE: That upload or request is too large to send. Try a smaller file.
error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check your input and try again: {{details}}
error.INVALID_STATE: That action cannot run right now. Refresh and try again.
error.UNAUTHORIZED: This Flow Studio link needs a fresh access key. Reopen Flow Studio from the launcher.
error.FORBIDDEN_HOST: Access blocked. Open Flow Studio directly from this computer.
error.NOT_FOUND: That file or page could not be found.
error.JOB_NOT_FOUND: Could not find job {{jobId}}. Check Monitor for the current job list.
error.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: That media file could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong while completing that request. Try again, or restart Flow Studio if it keeps happening.
error.MAX_CREDITS_EXCEEDED: Flow quoted {{cost}} credits for this scene, which is above your {{maxCredits}}-credit limit. Nothing ran and no credits were spent. Raise your credit limit or pick a lower-cost model, length, or quality.
error.INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Account "{{label}}" does not have enough credits for this job, and no enabled backup account is available. Add credits to "{{label}}" or add and enable a backup in Accounts.
error.AUTO_FAILOVER_DISABLED: Account "{{label}}" does not have enough credits for this job, and automatic credit failover is turned off. Turn on Automatic credit failover in Accounts, switch accounts, or add credits to "{{label}}".
error.ACCOUNT_BOUND_FAILOVER_BLOCKED: Account "{{label}}" ran out of credits, and this job cannot fail over because its Flow-hosted assets or clip edits belong to "{{label}}"'s project. Add credits to "{{label}}", or use local files from your saved films folder so jobs can run on backup accounts.
error.FAILOVER_EXHAUSTED: Account "{{label}}" ran out of credits and no backup account could finish this job ({{summary}}). Switched back to "{{label}}". Add credits or sign in to a backup account in Accounts, then retry.

hint.signIn: Not signed in yet. Open Accounts and select Sign in (or run npm run login), then sign in to Google in the Chrome window.
hint.authInProgress: Google sign-in is open in the Flow Chrome window. Finish signing in there and Flow Studio will connect automatically.
hint.noProject: Signed in, but no Flow project is open yet. Select New project or open a project in the Flow Chrome window.
hint.needsRelogin: The browser folder for "{{label}}" went missing, so cached balance details were cleared. Select Sign in in Accounts to restore access.
hint.staleCleared: Switched to "{{label}}". Cleared media lists, character picks, and scene references from the previous account.
hint.switchInProgress: Switching Flow accounts now. Wait a moment for Chrome to reopen before starting work.
hint.registryCorrupt: Your saved account list could not be read and was left untouched. Restore a backup copy or move the damaged file aside, then reload Studio.

dialog.title: Accounts
dialog.subtitle: Keep each Google Flow login, character list, and credit balance separate while sharing your saved films.

loading.heading: Loading accounts...
loading.description: Checking your saved accounts and current Flow status.

empty.heading: Only one account so far
empty.description: Add another Google account to track its credits separately and switch cleanly whenever you need more.

populated.heading: Your Flow accounts
populated.description: Priority runs from top to bottom. Only one account uses Flow Chrome at a time.

error.heading: Could not load accounts
error.description: Your saved account list ran into a problem, so account changes are paused to protect your data. Review the message below and try again.

switching.heading: Switching accounts...
switching.description: Closing the current Chrome session and opening the selected account. Wait until this finishes.

credits.skipZeroDetail: Skipped on failover for paid shots for up to 24 hours. Refresh this account to update sooner.
credits.skipCostDetail: Skipped on failover for shots costing {{minCost}}+ credits (<24h). Lower-cost shots still qualify.
credits.staleRecheckNote: Last credit check is over 24 hours old (>24h), so failover will re-check this account live.
credits.freeFramesUnaffected: Free Frames (0 credits) are unaffected and keep running normally.
credits.ttlHint: Low or zero credit flags clear automatically on refresh or after 24 hours.

failover.helper: When the active account runs out of credits, automatically switch down your priority list for portable images and videos. Jobs using Flow-hosted assets or clip edits stay on their owning account.
failover.emptyHint: Add another Google account or enable a backup below so automatic credit failover can switch when credits run out.
failover.lockedBusy: Wait for the current Flow job or action to finish before changing automatic credit failover.
failover.lockedSwitching: Wait for the active account switch to finish before changing automatic credit failover.
failover.switchedPreserved: Switched to "{{label}}". Reloaded account lists; your unsent scene drafts stay preserved.

evaluating.heading: Checking backup accounts...
evaluating.description: Account "{{fromLabel}}" ran out of credits. Looking down your priority list for an eligible backup.

switching.heading: Switching to "{{toLabel}}"...
switching.description: Saving "{{fromLabel}}"'s Flow project and opening "{{toLabel}}" in Chrome to continue this job.

verifying.heading: Verifying "{{toLabel}}"...
verifying.description: Checking sign-in status, Flow project, and available credits on "{{toLabel}}".

reverting.heading: Switching back to "{{fromLabel}}"...
reverting.description: No backup account could finish this job. Returning Flow Chrome to "{{fromLabel}}".

disabled.activeDisable: Switch to another account before disabling this one.
disabled.activeRemove: Switch to another account before removing this one.
disabled.defaultRemove: Your primary account cannot be removed.
disabled.soleEnabled: At least one account must stay enabled.
disabled.disabledSwitch: Enable this account before switching to it.
disabled.inactiveNewProject: Switch to this account first to start a new Flow project.
disabled.inactiveRefresh: Switch to this account first to check its live balance.
disabled.busySwitch: Wait for the current Flow job or action to finish before switching.
disabled.firstPriority: Already at the top of your list.
disabled.lastPriority: Already at the bottom of your list.

form.addHelper: Use 1 to 60 characters so each account is easy to recognize.
form.errorEmpty: Enter an account name. Blank spaces alone cannot be used.
form.errorTooLong: Use {{max}} characters or fewer for the account name.
form.errorDuplicate: An account named "{{label}}" already exists. Pick a different name.

trash.title: Remove "{{label}}"?
trash.body: This removes "{{label}}" from your account list and moves its browser profile and account characters to {{binName}}.
trash.reassurance: Your downloaded films, saved keys, and uploads stay safe. Re-adding "{{label}}" later creates a fresh folder.

newProject.title: Start a new Flow project
newProject.description: Opens an empty project in Flow for the active account. Characters belong to each project, so create them again if needed.
newProject.placeholder: Leave blank for Flow's default name
newProject.successUntitled: Started a new empty Flow project.

monitor.retryBlockedMessage: This job started on "{{jobAccount}}", while "{{activeAccount}}" is currently active. Switch back to "{{jobAccount}}" first, then retry.
monitor.retryBlockedHint: Switch to "{{jobAccount}}" in Accounts to retry this job.
monitor.retryBoundReason: Uses Flow-hosted assets or clip edits from "{{jobAccount}}", so it can only retry on "{{jobAccount}}".

drafts.framesDescription: Some frame references come from {{sourceLabels}}, not active account "{{activeLabel}}". Clear them or switch accounts before rendering.
drafts.framesAgentIgnored: Some frame references come from {{sourceLabels}}, not active account "{{activeLabel}}". They are ignored while Flow agent is selected.
drafts.shotsDescription: Some shot frames or references come from {{sourceLabels}}, not active account "{{activeLabel}}". Clear them or switch accounts before rolling.
drafts.castDescription: This character picture comes from {{sourceLabels}}, not active account "{{activeLabel}}". Clear it or switch accounts before creating.
drafts.rollBlockedReason: Clear mismatched assets or switch to {{sourceLabels}} to run
drafts.castBlockedReason: Clear the mismatched picture or switch to {{sourceLabels}} before creating.

toast.added: Added "{{label}}". Select Sign in when ready.
toast.signInOpened: Opened Chrome for "{{label}}". Finish signing in there.
toast.loginReverted: Chrome closed before sign-in finished. Switched back to "{{previousLabel}}".
